rv.q: Moonlight knows exactly how to play that hand.
Moonlight’s latest is a joyful addition to their 45th season in Vista.
Its story is G-rated, so it's family-friendly, and its consistently funny book, energetic choreography and great songs will appeal to all ages.

cn.t: Moonlight's production of this Golden Age classic sparkles with terrific choreography, strong performances, and fresh staging that makes the 1950 musical feel lively and new.
